sources.name: SpecGR

assertions.finding: CLI eval_mode is ignored at the final call and test is forced. A validation-only wrapper is mandatory before any project data is connected.
Checkpoint loading is hard-coded to cuda:0. Device-safe path adaptation is required for a local native run.
Official IDs are fixed-width RQ-VAE codes; GRAM paths are variable-length lexical paths and require a new path contract.
Quick start requests four GPUs and cannot be used as-is under the project resource policy.

sources.name: GenRecEdit

assertions.finding: The training script calls absent main.py; rec_main.py is the apparent repository entrypoint. Any path-only correction must be logged as an entry bug fix.
Probability probing hard-codes a 256-token codebook per SID position and cannot be applied directly to GRAM lexical paths.
The native method assumes four SID positions; GRAM needs explicit variable-length position/EOS/padding behavior.
Model placement defaults to the current CUDA device and needs a resource-policy wrapper.
The compact native evaluator matches a three-position SID prefix; it is not the project strict item-level evaluator.
The official cold split is derived from its test data. Native results must stay separate and this path is forbidden for the GRAM port.
